entities.summary: Jones Very was an American poet, essayist, clergyman, and mystic associated with the American Transcendentalism movement. He was known as a scholar of William Shakespeare, and many of his poems were Shakespearean sonnets. He was well-known and respected among the Transcendentalists. Jones Very was a philosophers & thinkers from Salem (1813-10-28, Salem–1880-05-08). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
